title: Allow the Weather plasmoid to automatically change location to current location
line: The Weather widget can now detect your location automatically and show the weather wherever you are.
explanation: The Weather widget only knew a fixed place chosen by searching for a weather station, so the forecast stayed on that place when the laptop moved. There was no way to use the system's location service, even though Night Light already uses it through QtPositioning and GeoClue. The settings page now has a "Detect my location automatically" checkbox; when it is on, the widget follows the position from the location service (rounded to about 1 km) and fetches the forecast from Open-Meteo, which works worldwide from coordinates. If no location can be determined, the widget says so and offers to set a location manually; the manually chosen place is kept for when the option is turned off.

commits.message:
applets/weather: Add an option to detect the current location

The widget only showed the weather for a fixed place, so it was wrong
whenever the device moved. It can now follow the location reported by
the system's location service, like Night Light, with Open-Meteo data.

BUG: 475219

media.caption: Before: the widget always shows the place picked by hand (Berlin), wherever the device is
After: with the new option on, it shows the weather for the current location (fake location service reporting Rome)
Before: the settings page only offers searching for a weather station
After: "Detect my location automatically" checkbox; the search is disabled while it is on
After: the location service reports a move to Oslo and the widget follows it by itself
After: when no location service is available, the widget explains it and offers to set a location
